HEMFRID SÖKER STÄDARE I LIDINGÖ – BLI EN DEL AV VÅRT TEAM!
Vill du ha ett jobb där du verkligen gör skillnad i människors vardag? Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet, alltid med kvalitet och omtanke.
Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som städare i Lidingö med omnejd. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen, tillsammans levererar vi service i världsklass!
Vad erbjuder vi?
· En tjänst på 75 %
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år
· Gratis mobilabonnemang
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester
Hos oss får du rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas. Har du viljan, så ger vi dig verktygen för att briljera!

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som:
· Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och i team
· Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och engagerad
· Vill utvecklas och lära dig mer
· Talar svenska eller engelska
· Kan arbeta flexibla arbetstider (måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–17.00)
· Är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder
Meriterande:
· B-körkort (egen bil är ett plus)
· Erfarenhet av städning eller serviceyrken

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN LIDINGÖ– JOIN OUR TEAM!
Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner in Lidingö and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· A 75% position
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Meritorious:
· B driver’s license (own car is a plus)
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

jobs.occupation: Head of Digital & IT to Nordic Outdoor Group
jobs.employer_name: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
jobs.description:
About Nordic Outdoor Group Established in 2024, Nordic Outdoor Group brings together leading brands within sports fishing, including Vision, iFish and Sølvkroken. Today, the group consists of seven companies and nine brands, operating across Nordic and European markets. With approximately 50 employees the group operates primarily B2B, supplying retailers and distributors across Europe.
Each company maintains its own identity and commercial independence, while benefiting from shared resources and expertise. By developing common solutions within IT, warehousing and logistics, including a new central warehouse in Habo, Sweden, Nordic Outdoor Group creates opportunities for more efficient operations and continued growth.
About the role As Head of Digital & IT, you’ll take overall responsibility for IT, digitalization and AI across Nordic Outdoor Group. This is a newly established position where you’ll report to the Group CEO, be part of the group management team and work closely with the local management teams, combining strategic responsibility with hands-on project delivery. As the first group-level role beyond the CEO, backed by an active owner, you’ll have a broad mandate to shape and drive the group’s digital development – including ownership of the group’s IT and digital budget and of our external technology partners. Roadmap work is already underway, so you’ll build on a solid starting point rather than a blank sheet.
A central part of your work will be creating a unified and efficient digital environment across our businesses. With Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Plytix and Shopify (for B2B and B2C) as our chosen platforms, you’ll lead implementations and integrations to improve processes across sales, order management and logistics.
Your responsibilities include:

Leading system implementations and integration projects across ERP, PIM, e-commerce and warehouse management.

Developing and prioritizing our digital and IT roadmap based on business needs.

Driving AI adoption and automation to simplify processes and improve efficiency.

Improving data quality and availability for reporting, analysis and business decisions.

Managing IT security, external technology partners and suppliers, as well as IT and project budgets. 

Who are we looking for? We’re looking for someone with typically 10+ years of relevant experience in IT, digitalization or business development, including leading larger system implementations or transformation projects. You understand how ERP, e-commerce and logistics systems connect and can translate business needs into technical solutions. You are also a regular user of AI tools and understand how they can be applied to improve business processes. Experience from a multi-company, multi-brand or acquisition-driven environment is a strong advantage. You are comfortable with data, reporting and BI, and understand what it takes to give management and owners live, correct figures across several companies. You are fluent in English and in Swedish or another Scandinavian language.
As a person, you’re pragmatic, commercially minded and comfortable working independently. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and know how to build trust, involve others and drive projects forward.
The position is based in Sweden, preferably in the Jönköping or Gothenburg area, although we’re flexible regarding location. Hybrid and remote working arrangements are possible, with travel to our businesses across the Nordics.
What we offer A rare combination of strategic mandate and hands-on freedom: the roadmap, the architecture and the way the group works with technology are yours to shape. You join a growing group with an active acquisition agenda, which means the scope of the role grows with the group, and a management team that has made digital a group-level priority. We offer a competitive package, genuine flexibility on where you work, and an industry with passionate customers and products.
Applications will be reviewed continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Nordic Outdoor Group is partnering with Ants Tech Recruiters for this recruitment. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Karin Forsmark at karin.forsmark@ants.se.

The opportunity
Join our IT Team supporting the Grid Integration HVDC business in Ludvika, part of Hitachi Energy. HVDC specializes in innovative and reliable solutions for power transmission and distribution, supporting efficient and sustainable energy systems worldwide.
As a Site IT/OT Service Delivery Specialist in Ludvika, you will support IT/OT solutions and services, working closely with business leaders and IT stakeholders. Your role includes managing IT infrastructure, applications, and ticket escalations, as well as supporting both office and shop floor IT/OT assets.
You will be working in close collaboration with the Service Delivery Specialist for HVDC Ludvika, ensuring business needs are met and overall satisfaction with IT services. Additionally, you will play a crucial role in integrating IT with the business operations, enhancing connectivity and cybersecurity for all operational technologies.
“This is a new, dynamic and fast-moving area where you will have the opportunity to influence and grow in the role and within the company. “– Britt Marie Gustafsson, GPG HVDC IT Service Delivery Manager.
How you’ll make an impact
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the business in their growth
Overseeing and acting as a point of contact for the IT/OT environment and responding to emergencies
Supporting the Service Delivery Specialist who is responsible for the HVDC site in Ludvika
Participate in planning, developing, implementing and maintaining the HVDC IT/OT environment
You are a team player who can also handle tasks independently and take on responsibility
You have a willingness to learn and try new things and enjoy collaborating with others

Your background
You have 3-5 years of work experience, ideally in a similar role
Experience with manufacturing operations methods, processes, and change management is an advantage
You have experience handling complex stakeholder scenarios and cross-functional problem solving. You also have a solid understanding of IT procedures, policies, and end-to-end business processes
Hands-on, installation, troubleshooting etc. on applications & infrastructure
You are fluent in English and Swedish

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer, Secure Meters (Sweden) AB
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled Embedded Software Developer with deep experience in Embedded Linux and C programming? Do you want to build solutions for the global energy transition together with an international engineering team?
Secure Meters is looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Software Developer to join the engineering team in Nyköping.
In this role, you will work on innovative and technically challenging projects, developing embedded software solutions and reusable components while exploring emerging technologies. You will collaborate closely with the local Swedish engineering team as well as engineering teams in India.
Location: Nyköping, Sweden (Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week on-site).
The Role
As a Senior Embedded Software Developer at Secure Meters, you play a key part in designing and delivering high-quality software for advanced energy measurement and grid management systems. You take ownership of technical challenges from concept to deployment, working with modern toolchains and automated testing to ensure reliability and scalability.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain embedded software solutions, primarily using Embedded Linux.
Contribute to overall system architecture and software design.
Develop portable, reusable software components and evaluate new technologies through prototypes and proof-of-concept projects.
Write high-quality, efficient and maintainable code supported by automated testing.
Collaborate with engineering teams in Sweden and India to deliver innovative technical solutions.
Participate actively in technical discussions, code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Keep up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends and best practices in embedded systems.
Continuously develop technical skills and share expertise through team meetings, workshops and mentoring.

Qualifications & Experience
You may currently work in a role such as:
Senior Embedded Software Developer
Embedded Linux Engineer
Firmware Engineer
Embedded Systems Architect

Essential requirements:
Minimum 6 years of professional embedded software development experience.
Bachelor's degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
Strong hands-on experience with Embedded Linux.
High proficiency in C programming.
Solid understanding of system architecture and software design principles.
Demonstrated experience in writing portable and reusable code, verified by automated testing.
Hands-on experience using Git daily in modern team workflows.
Practical experience with JTAG/SWD or remote debugging techniques.
Experience with developing, integrating and utilizing open-source software packages.
Experience with Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines and modern build workflows.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Desirable experience:
Experience working with RTOS (Real-Time Operating Systems).
Domain background in power grids, energy management, smart metering or industrial data acquisition.
Experience building rapid prototypes and evaluating emerging hardware/software technologies.
Conversational or professional Swedish is an advantage.

Personal Attributes
To thrive in this role, we believe you are:
Innovative, curious and open-minded, with a genuine interest in exploring new technologies.
A technical problem-solver who takes ownership of challenges and proactively drives solutions.
Comfortable working in an international, collaborative and supportive team environment.
Driven by a continuous learning mindset, eager to develop and share knowledge with colleagues.
Adaptable to evolving project requirements, technologies and engineering practices.

About Secure Meters
Secure Meters is a global provider of advanced solutions for measuring, monitoring and managing energy consumption. With more than 7,200 employees across 10 countries, we are a leading player in the energy sector, partnering with utilities and businesses to create sustainable, efficient and innovative solutions for electricity distribution and transmission. Our products are deployed in over 70 countries, helping customers make better, data-driven decisions about their energy use. Through continuous engineering innovation and customer focus, we remain at the forefront of the industry.
To learn more about our business and how we drive progress in the energy sector, visit www.securemeters.com to explore our solutions and our commitment to a sustainable future.
We welcome you to join our engineering team in Nyköping and contribute to Secure Meters' continued growth and technology leadership!
Application
We collaborate with Addilon in this recruitment. Please submit your application (CV and cover letter in English) as soon as possible via the link below. The selection process is ongoing and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
